question: Who founded the 'Slave Dynasty'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Qutb-ud-din Aibak.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Slave dynasty** was the first dynasty in Delhi Sultanate.
 
• The Slave dynasty is also known as the **Mamluk dynasty.**
 
• The Slave dynasty ruled between** 1206 and 1290.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• The Slave dynasty was founded by **Quṭb al-Dīn Aibak.**__
 
• Qutb al-Din Aibak was a general of the **Muhammad Ghori. **
 
• He ruled the Slave Dynasty between **1206 and 1210.**
 
• He was the real founder of **Turkish rule in India.**
 
• The UNESCO World Heritage Site **Qutb Minar** was built around 1192 by Qutb-ud-din Aibak.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Razia Sultan** was the first female Muslim ruler of the subcontinent and the only female Muslim ruler of Delhi.
 
• **Nasir-ud-din Mahmud** was the eighth sultan of the Mamluk Sultanate in Delhi.
 
• **Ghiyas-ud-din Balban** was the ninth sultan of the Mamluk dynasty of Delhi.
